$comment: BI Agent Harness hooks for VS Code Copilot (agent hooks). The installer copies this file to .github/hooks/bi-harness.json with --enable-hooks; VS Code needs chat.useHooks on and a trusted workspace. Commands are repo-relative shell strings run from the repository root; BI_HARNESS_HOST tells the scripts to translate VS Code's tool names and input shapes (hardening/hooks/lib/host-vscode.mjs). VS Code ignores matchers, so every hook sees every tool and filters itself. The Claude registration of hardening/settings.hooks.json is the same kind of repo-relative shell string; VS Code also runs .github/hooks/bi-harness.copilot-cli.json and, with chat.useClaudeHooks, that registration too: each hook then runs two or three times per event, a model write is recorded once per call (its tool_use_id, or its tool, request and timestamp) and every later copy repeats the verdict given to the same Stop event (its timestamp) instead of counting a second stop.
